source.compositionRights: The traditional Süssmayr Agnus Dei is public domain.
source.evidence: The source repository includes the exact K626 Requiem 12 agnus dei.mid file (67,774 bytes; Git blob d7b3c4e869ddb1a4c777d23e071129a50cedb0ef) and its README states that the MIDI dataset is licensed under CC0 1.0. This resolves the redistribution-rights blocker while retaining the previously verified 51-measure / 17-part full-orchestral acceptance target. The combined witness duration is ~481 quarter units, exactly matching 51 measures of 3/4 Agnus Dei (153 quarters) plus 82 measures of 4/4 Communio (328 quarters); this manifest extracts source measures 1–51.

ingest.label: Agnus Dei, K.626 — complete traditional Süssmayr full-orchestral rendition
ingest.description: Complete source-MIDI-derived Agnus Dei Full Rendition extracted from measures 1–51 of the CC0 K.626 tail witness. The same source continues directly into the 82-measure Communio after the 3/4 → 4/4 boundary.

sourceCandidates.reason: Exact full Agnus MIDI is present in a repository whose README explicitly releases the dataset under CC0 1.0; selected to clear the rights gate.
Ingested candidate produced only 6 note-bearing tracks / 1,324 events: a vocal-organ reduction.
Exact Full Rendition target signature; ScoreTail supports MusicXML/MIDI export, but a direct redistribution-clean machine-readable export URL has not yet been acquired.
Public-domain full score confirms the traditional orchestration; not yet a machine-readable symbolic witness.
Confirms Süssmayr's Agnus Dei orchestration: strings, two basset horns, two bassoons, two trumpets in D, timpani, three trombones colla parte where indicated, SATB, organ and bass.
